Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

reply.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note that we have not received a reply to our previous offer. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We maintain our offer of €31.50 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months for the requested volume of 23,400 units over a 36-month contract. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Please let us know your decision so we can proceed.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

Thank you for your offer; we are ready to discuss a binding longer-term commitment in return for securing the full annual volume we request. We are flexible on contract duration and lead times, provided the volume commitment is dependable. Please explore what adjustments you can make within your approval authority as a first step.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10). Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.57 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We acknowledge receipt of your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
For the record:
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have reviewed your data and can accommodate the requested volume of 23,400 units over a 36-month contract.
In exchange for these terms and the 56-day lead time, we are prepared to adjust our price to €31.50 per unit.
This offer reflects the maximum commercial flexibility available for this configuration.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Which volume can you commit to?
Please address any further questions in writing to this office.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You have confirmed capacity for our full requirement and still ask what we can commit to—it sounds like certainty of demand is central to securing that capacity. Our firm long-term commitment is intended to support your capacity planning and dependable supply for us. How can we translate that commitment into a firm allocation covering our full requirement?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.11 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
